description.fun: Clamperl clamps its shell shut on prey and won't let go until it stops moving. The pearls it makes amplify psychic power, which is why Spoink wear them on their heads. When it's close to evolving, it grows too big for its shell. Drifblim sometimes carry Clamperl from place to place, and now and then one goes missing along the way.
description.guide: A Water-type Pokémon based on an oyster or giant clam, living on the sea floor and producing pearls that boost psychic power. It evolves into Huntail when traded holding a Deep Sea Tooth or into Gorebyss when traded holding a Deep Sea Scale.
description.tagline: A pearl-making clam that can evolve two different ways

branches.text: Clamperl evolves only by trade: holding a Deep Sea Tooth it becomes Huntail, and holding a Deep Sea Scale it becomes Gorebyss. It's the only Pokémon that evolves by trade holding one of two different items.

description.fun: Huntail lurks in the dark, high-pressure depths of the sea, where its sturdy spine and big eyes help it survive. It lures prey by wagging the fish-shaped tip of its tail, complete with glowing eyespots, then gulps it down whole. By tradition, a Huntail washing up on shore is a sign that something bad is about to happen, echoing a real belief that stranded deep-sea fish foretell disasters.
description.guide: A Water-type Pokémon resembling a deep-sea eel, living in the dark depths of the sea. It evolves from Clamperl when traded holding a Deep Sea Tooth.
description.tagline: A deep-sea eel that lures prey with a fish-shaped tail

description.fun: Gorebyss looks graceful, but it stabs prey with its long, thin mouth and drains their body fluids, though it also nibbles seaweed between the rocks. Its pink skin brightens in spring and after a meal, and its colour changes with the water temperature, so Gorebyss in Alola are blindingly vivid. With the shells on its chest it looks rather like a mermaid. Its Japanese name, Sakurabyss, mixes cherry blossom with abyss.
description.guide: A Water-type Pokémon resembling a snipe eel, with a body tough enough for the pressure of the deep sea. It evolves from Clamperl when traded holding a Deep Sea Scale.
description.tagline: A pink deep-sea mermaid with a needle-sharp mouth
